conventions: Avoid structure_type class/function modify-by-name on any declaration whose signature contains a brace ('{'/'}') before its real body opens (e.g. a lambda default parameter like `onSettings: () -> Unit = {}`, or a brace-less one-line data class) -- the anchor resolver's brace-span scan can walk past the intended declaration into unrelated later code. Use structure_type constant/block with an explicit, verified-unique start_anchor (+end_anchor) instead for those cases.
